itemsInNoOrder.snippet:
YaCy is free software for your own search engine.
YaCy is free search engine software for local search, organization-wide search portals, and a decentralized peer-to-peer web index.

itemsInNoOrder.title: Demo - YaCy
itemsInNoOrder.snippet:
Search
YaCy can search a local index, a portal index, or peer-to-peer data from the shared network. The result page is the main interface your users will see.
Search results using peer-to-peer data.
